root_cause: No execution feedback loop: literal/value mismatches, invented columns and projection choices go unchecked
what: Add a validate-and-repair pass: run the draft query, and if it errors or returns 0 rows, send the model the error plus grounded diagnostics (real stored values near each referenced string literal, actual table columns) and generic SQLite rules, allowing one revised query. Also strengthen the system prompt with value-matching, column-existence and projection guidance.
decision: s1 delivers a solid +3.34 evolve gain (86.67 vs 83.33) with only one regression, and its validate-and-repair loop plus grounded value/column diagnostics is a generic SQLite mechanism rather than task-specific patching; the token rise to 912 stays within the admissibility cost rule, so the measured benefit outweighs the added complexity.

root_cause: Blind single-shot harness: no execution feedback, so zero-row results from wrong literals/LIKE patterns/join keys are never detected or repaired
what: Turn solve() into a draft-execute-repair loop that uses env.execute on every draft and, when the result is empty or errors, feeds back concrete diagnostics (which WHERE literals are absent from their column, sample values, whether dropping LIKE wildcards matches, declared FKs and real column names) in one corrective policy call. Add prompt rules for value matching, join keys, NULL-safe anti-joins and 'which <entity>' projection width.

root_cause: Repair loop only triggers on errors/0 rows, so silent duplicate-row inflation (join fan-out without DISTINCT) and projection-width mistakes are never detected
what: Add a generic duplicate-result detector: when the draft executes successfully but its result multiset contains repeated rows, trigger the existing repair call with grounded feedback (total vs distinct row counts plus repeated rows) and guidance to add DISTINCT or restructure joins/aggregation. This targets join fan-out duplicates (sp0536, sp0600) and also catches anti-join queries returning suspiciously empty results already handled; prompt gets one matching rule about DISTINCT after multi-row joins.
decision: cost rule failed: gain +0.0000 within delta 0.0596; shaped -0.712 <= 0

root_cause: Repair triggers only on error/0 rows, so duplicate-row fan-out from joins (missing DISTINCT) and wrong projection width pass silently; guidance also over-broadens SELECT *
what: Extend the repair trigger to detect repeated identical result rows (a join-fanout signal) and feed back a targeted dedup/DISTINCT diagnostic plus observed result shape, and tighten the entity-projection rule in both prompt and guidance to default to exactly the asked columns (SELECT * only when the question explicitly asks for all details). This targets sp0536/sp0600 (duplicates) and sp0755 (over-narrow projection vs gold's full join rows) without touching the working literal-probe path.

root_cause: Repair loop only fires on error/0 rows; silent join-fanout duplicates and narrow projections pass unchecked, and repairs lack grounded column facts
what: Extend the single repair pass to trigger on silently-wrong drafts: repeated identical result rows (fan-out) or an entity-style question answered with fewer columns than the entity table has; feed back the observed duplicates plus the ACTUAL columns of every referenced table (fixes invented anti-join id columns), and add explicit DISTINCT/projection decision rules to the prompts.
